requirements.text: TextualPathExp is part of the package TextualPathExp
In a textual path, a transition could be multiple.
The TextualPathExp model includes an AlternativeTrans class.
The PrimitieTrans class has a name attribute of type String.
A TextualPathExp has exactly one path.
A path contains at least one transition.
An AlternativeTrans belongs to one or more Paths.
